title: Amazon Boxing Day sale 2026: dates, what to expect and prices to beat
seoTitle: Amazon Boxing Day Sale 2026 UK: Dates & What to Expect
description: When Amazon's Boxing Day sale 2026 is likely to start, what was discounted last year, and the Black Friday prices it needs to beat.
intro:
**Amazon's Boxing Day sale 2026 is most likely to start on Saturday 26 December, as it did on Boxing Day last year.** Amazon hasn't announced its plans yet. In 2025 the deals went live on 26 December, some ended the same day, and others ran into January.

Boxing Day prices often match Black Friday rather than beat it. So if something you want is at the Black Friday prices below, buying now is usually the safer bet. The cards below show what Amazon is charging this weekend (27–28 November 2026), the prices Boxing Day would have to beat. For more, see our [Boxing Day sales 2026 guide](/guides/boxing-day-sales-2026-uk/) and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

body:
## When is the Amazon Boxing Day sale 2026?

Boxing Day 2026 is on **Saturday 26 December**, and the bank holiday moves to Monday 28 December. Last year Amazon UK's Boxing Day deals were live on the morning of 26 December 2025 (TechRadar, 26 December 2025). Amazon didn't give an official end date: some deals ended that day, and many ran into the New Year.

We'll update this page as soon as Amazon announces anything. Amazon usually confirms its December events only a few days ahead.

## Do you need Prime for Amazon's Boxing Day sale?

Mostly no. Last year's Boxing Day deals were generally open to everyone, though some deals may be Prime-only. Prime does get you free delivery, which matters on low-priced items. If you don't have it, a [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) is free for 30 days and can be cancelled before it renews. Our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time it.

## What was in Amazon's Boxing Day sale last year?

In 2025 TechRadar's Amazon UK Boxing Day roundup covered kitchen appliances (Shark, Ninja, Philips), beauty and electric toothbrushes (Gillette, Oral-B), vacuums (Dyson, Shark, Vax), TVs, laptops, Kindles and tablets, headphones, smart home (Ring, Blink, Echo), Fire TV sticks, toys, games and fashion. Expect a similar mix this year, plus Amazon's own devices.

## Is Boxing Day cheaper than Black Friday on Amazon?

Usually not by much. Last year:

- Some prices simply **returned to Black Friday levels**. The Ninja Double Stack XL was back to its Black Friday price, and AirPods Pro 2 were still at their Black Friday price.
- A few items hit **record lows**, mostly Amazon devices and older models being cleared.
- Some were **dearer than earlier in December**. One Boxing Day preview listed a Ring doorbell at £49.99 that had been £39.99 earlier that month.

The pattern: popular gifts (AirPods, Lego, Ring, Kindles) rarely get cheaper after Christmas, because demand has already peaked and stock is lower. Clearance lines, fashion, last year's TVs and laptops, and Christmas leftovers are where Boxing Day tends to win.

## Buy now or wait for Boxing Day?

- **Buy now** if it's a Christmas present, if it's at or near the prices above, or if it's one of this year's most popular gifts. Waiting risks it selling out or the price going back up in December.
- **Wait** for clothes, shoes, homeware and big-ticket items like TVs and laptops that aren't needed before Christmas. These often see deeper cuts in the Boxing Day and January sales.

A useful habit: note the price on Black Friday, then check again on 26 December. If Boxing Day turns out lower, check the returns window on your order: Amazon usually extends returns for items bought in the run-up to Christmas, but confirm the date on your order page.

## Got Christmas money for books?

If you want Audible, Amazon's current offer (£0.99 a month for three months for eligible members) ends on 17 December, before Boxing Day. Our [Audible free trial guide](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) has the details. Kindle readers can also try [Kindle Unlimited](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku) free.

## FAQs

### When does the Amazon Boxing Day sale start in 2026?

Amazon hasn't confirmed it. Last year the deals were live on Boxing Day morning (26 December), so expect the same on Saturday 26 December 2026.

### How long does the Amazon Boxing Day sale last?

There's no fixed end date. In 2025 some deals lasted a single day, while others carried on into January alongside the New Year sales.

### Is the Amazon Boxing Day sale better than Black Friday?

Rarely for popular gifts. Most prices last year matched Black Friday rather than beat it. Boxing Day is better for clearance stock, fashion and older tech.

### Do I need Prime for Amazon Boxing Day deals?

Not for most of them, but Prime gives free delivery and occasionally early or exclusive deals. A 30-day free trial covers the sale.
